prose: The long-awaited BioCharisma/InnerVerse swapcast is finally here! This is an in-person hangout Topher Gardner and I recorded awhile back, that we lost due to technical difficulties but managed to resurrect without video. It's a deep energy soul massage transmitted through a goofy and heartfelt mind meld between two great friends.
music: InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
